description: Classifies a filing or announcement title into interrupt / context / noise for the intraday catalyst probe. Ordered: the first matching rule wins. An unmatched item defaults to `context` — unknown is never silently dropped. Only `interrupt` may be treated as a hard catalyst, and even then the catalyst gate decides.

rules.pattern: (?i)^(form\s*)?(3|4|5)\b|statement of changes in beneficial ownership|initial statement of beneficial ownership
rules.why: routine insider paperwork; a Form 4 explains almost no intraday move

rules.pattern: (?i)^144\b|notice of proposed sale
rules.why: proposed-sale notice, filed continuously by large holders
passive stake disclosure; 13D is the activist form and stays an interrupt

rules.pattern: (?i)\b8-k\b|\b6-k\b|results of operations
(?i)\b424b|\bs-1\b|\bs-3\b|prospectus supplement|at-the-market
(?i)\b10-q\b|\b10-k\b|\b20-f\b|annual report|quarterly report
(?i)\bnt\s*10-[qk]\b|notification of late filing
rules.why: a late filing is itself a governance signal

rules.pattern: (?i)\bsc\s*to\b|\b425\b|defm14a|merger

rules.why: governance and holdings paperwork worth knowing, rarely intraday

rules.pattern: 翌日披露报表|月报表|证券变动月报表|下一营业日披露报表
rules.why: mandatory daily/monthly share-movement returns; pure filing noise

rules.pattern: 法律意见书|律师事务所关于
rules.why: supporting legal paperwork attached to another announcement

rules.pattern: 盈利警告|盈警|盈喜|盈利预喜|正面盈利
内幕消息|须予公布的交易|非常重大
配售|供股|发行新股|认购事项|可转换债券|先旧后新
收购|要约|合并|出售股权|重大资产
停牌|短暂停止买卖|复牌|恢复买卖
rules.why: trading status change explains a move better than any headline

rules.pattern: 业绩公告|中期业绩|年度业绩|季度业绩|未经审核
购回股份|股份回购(?!报表)
rules.why: buyback decision (the daily return is caught by the noise rule above)

rules.pattern: 董事会会议|股东(特别)?大会|委任|辞任|更改|授出购股权
